apps.name: WearBridge
apps.versionDescription: Complete WearBridge release with ANCS notifications, Quick Reply BLE transport, BAS 0x180F Battery widget support, brand badges, and Apple HealthKit sync.
apps.localizedDescription: Bridge your Samsung Galaxy Watch / Wear OS watch to your iPhone. Enables ANCS notification mirroring, quick replies, native iOS battery widget integration, and health telemetry.
